Many people have strong opinions about the Seventh-day Adventist Church, but how many of those claims are actually true? In this video, we examine 5 common myths about Seventh-day Adventists, including accusations that they are legalistic, follow Ellen White more than the Bible, predicted the second coming of Jesus, are a cult, or believe only Adventists will be saved. Using Bible passages and historical context, we take a closer look at what Adventists actually believe about salvation by grace, the Ten Commandments, the Sabbath, and prophecy. You’ll also learn the real story behind the 1844 prophecy and the Millerite movement, and how these events shaped Adventist history. If you’ve ever wondered whether Adventists rely on the Bible or on human teachings, this video will help clarify the facts. Don’t rely on rumors—discover the truth about Adventist beliefs directly from Scripture. Watch the full video and decide for yourself.

Video chapters:

0:00 - Intro
12:04 - Seventh-day Adventists Are Legalistic
6:35 - Adventist Doctrines Come From Ellen White
8:26 - The Seventh-day Adventist Church Is a Cult
12:10 - Adventists Predicted Jesus Would Return in 1844
16:08 - Only Seventh-day Adventists Will Be Saved
